aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable NG-hearing evidence but overgroups many unrelated validation tests into one changed-factor case.
issues: Changed factor conflates material, equipment, lot, LED power, press head, yoke class, and method tests.
Baseline/test logic is ambiguous; VP old lot is used as control for unrelated later conditions despite Normal rows.
Outcomes mix comparable function NG rates with header-derived measurements and non-comparable summaries.
Several cited rows are absent from provided context or appear to be headers/summary tables, not direct evidence.
Worse judgement is not reliable because row dates, test items, and subgroup keys are not preserved.
requiredUserQuestions: Should this workbook be split into separate cases by test item/date rather than one combined case?
correctionPlan: Define separate changed-factor groups for each explicit test item or validation block.
Use Normal or same-date matching controls only where the source rows support that pairing.
Remove header-only and auto-stat measurement outcomes unless direct measured rows are cited.
Preserve row keys such as date, type, press head, VP mold, lot, yoke class, and LED condition.
Recompute judgements only for comparable input/NG/rate rows with paired evidence citations.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Current citations are insufficient; final evidence must cite direct condition/result rows for each comparison.
